scope: Manual source-level labels for the fixed four-question ABBA date-order POC; not a judge score or population estimate
label_rule: core_time_supported asks whether the answer gives the time warranted by the cited original turn and its session date; extra_precision_or_claim records material qualifiers and added details separately

cases.source_finding: May 20, 2022 session introduces Max as a new family member; May 2022 is supported, exact adoption day is not stated.
cases.extra_precision_or_claim: All four use around May 20; the source supports the month and a nearby date, not an exact adoption day.
cases.order_conclusion: No clear gain or harm in required time fact.

cases.source_finding: Deborah says her mother died a few years before the January 2023 conversation; her father died two days before the January 27, 2023 session. The parents' dates must remain distinct.
cases.core_time: 2023年前的几年；母亲具体日期未知
cases.extra_precision_or_claim: Chronological call 2 and legacy call 4 explicitly distinguish the father's January 25 death; this detail is sourced but unnecessary to answer. Legacy call 1 adds a broad 2022-or-earlier bound; it does not give a specific unsupported mother date.
cases.order_conclusion: Both orders preserve the mother/father distinction when stated; no stable order effect.
